potential.basis: local 5.85 km p95 frontier, best observed season (Yp)
potential.caveat: achievable yield varies little between GB fields (p10-p90 spans 0.5 t/ha) — the gap below it varies 4x more, so read the gap, not this class

gap.basis: weather + soil are the exact telescope terms; rotation, terrain and field-edge are marginal national/own-field contrasts carved out of the management gap; other_management is the residual UPPER BOUND

within_field.basis: 10 m pixels ranked inside the supplied polygon each season; Landsat seasons are 30 m pixels resampled to 10 m, and the spread uses Sentinel-2 seasons only

outlook.basis: empirical frequency and severity over the 13 observed seasons (2013-2025) at this location — 13 draws, so read it as an order of magnitude, not a probability. Which hazard drives it comes from the 1991-2020 climatology. NOT a climate-change projection

climate_risk.basis: class = the location's realised 2013-2025 weather gap against GB wheat; hazard = climatological frequency of the adverse season type
climate_risk.caveat: gap response varies little between fields (82% of GB fields respond positively to all three hazards) — read hazard and exposure, not the response class, as the discriminating signal

ranking.basis: percentile of fields with a LARGER persistent management gap — higher is better; neighbours = within 20 km, similar = 256 nearest in terrain/soil/climate space

productive_memory.percentile_note: share of neighbours/analogue fields with a LARGER persistent gap — higher = better

yield_gap.note: G_M is an UPPER BOUND on management (FRAMEWORK section 5)

rotation.reference: first wheat after a break crop, national mean 8.35 t/ha (2018-2025, n_px>=30)
rotation.caveat: average national contrasts, not causal effects

2015.position: no crop map for this season

within_field_split.note: observed = within-polygon sd of 10 m yields (full Sentinel-2 seasons); expected = national curve of that sd against sub-ha soil-texture SD (its intercept absorbs retrieval noise); the difference is an upper bound on what management could level out — curve intercept absorbs the retrieval noise floor; addressable spread = observed - curve, floor 0

within_field_variation.definition: pixels ranked within the supplied polygon per season (field mean, soil, rotation, season cancel); classes = binomial tail on quintile membership, alpha 0.05, >=3 seasons; season-sensitive = both tails hit at least once

field_edges.note: outer 20 m vs interior beyond 40 m, mean of full Sentinel-2 seasons

terrain.caveat: marginal contrast — terrain overlaps soil and climate; sub-terms of G_M may double count and are capped at G_M in the passport

performance.definition: share of the achievable yield realised, mean over the field's wheat seasons

gap_map.definition: mean G_M over the field's wheat seasons (>=3 yr per px), banded at 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 t/ha; 1.5-px gaussian + 4x bilinear upsample for display, statistics unsmoothed

risk.note: hazard = local climatological frequency of the adverse season type, as a GB-wheat percentile (11 km ERA5 — percentiles are robust, absolute day-counts are not); expected loss = gap response x realised local severity, so it differentiates fields even where all responses are positive

climate_behaviour.typed_note: gap response to the LOCAL dry/wet/hot season index, shrunk toward the regional slope (<=13 seasons per field); classes = national terciles
